scope: Process-bound shared same-host, same-PID-namespace pre-TLS ingress quotas; expired leases are reclaimed only after owner-process death is proven.

extra_final_code_gateway_focus.note: These methods are already included in the 51-method gateway suite; not added to combined total.

lease_reclamation_rule: TTL plus demonstrably dead/reused owner process; live or ambiguous owner retains slot.
schema_migration: v4.4 schema-1 databases fail closed; no implicit migration
known_limits: A live wedged process may hold capacity indefinitely until recovery/restart; availability is traded for avoiding unsafe TTL-only reclamation.
A resumed handler is not forcibly cancelled; this is lease/quota accounting protection, not a hard execution fence.
Linux /proc semantics required; same host and same PID namespace must share the exact trusted SQLite path and matching configuration.
The SQLite database and parent directory remain trusted local infrastructure and do not have cryptographic tamper resistance.
Full upstream package install and upstream CI were not run; no source files changed and no pull request was opened.
verification_boundary: Local reference artifact tests, with separate suite invocations. Not production certification and not evidence of upstream equivalence.
